title: Efficient Inference for Stochastic Interventions in Nested Markov Models with Multiple Verma Constraints
banked_reason: D-0.5 revision cap exhausted after five REVISE verdicts; the load-bearing G2 efficiency novelty claim is already supplied by Nabi–Guo–Liu (2026) Appendix S4.2.
gap_reasons: The G2 efficiency claim is already supplied by NabiGuoLiu2026 Appendix S4.2, yet v5 still characterizes it as partial and claims a new complete two-Verma efficiency result.
Phi_nu lacks a defined generic overlap domain.
H^s(O) and finite-alphabet Evans embedding lack a mixed finite/Euclidean Sobolev convention.
proof_attempt_summary: Five proposal revisions attempted to turn the multi-constraint tangent-space idea into a flagship theorem by adding a joint fixing map, a finite-recursion right inverse, causal stochastic-intervention identification, and learned-projector inference. The attempt collapsed because its concrete G2 efficiency novelty was already covered by Nabi–Guo–Liu (2026), while the generic overlap domain and mixed finite/Euclidean Sobolev model remained undefined. A future topic would need a genuinely distinct family of simultaneous Verma constraints and a fresh novelty check; continuing this angle would repeat the exhausted root.
tldr: Efficient inference for the graphically identified stochastic intervention \(\Psi_\nu(P)=E_P(Y^\nu)\) is developed on the explicit \(G_2\) ADMG with two genuine Verma constraints. A semantics-correct marginalized fixing map and finite recursive-head lift first prove tangent completeness on the larger laminar fixing-forest class. The \(G_2\) edge list then certifies that \(M\) is fixable with \(W=\operatorname{mp}_{G_2}(M)\), so the causal target has the published adjustment formula and unrestricted augmented-IPW gradient. Coherent fold-specific laws, observable fitted-law-centered affine projectors, and a derived implementation-centering error yield a causal one-step CLT, consistent empirical variance, and Wald coverage under learned post-fixing subspaces, closing angles, and weakening joint-fixing conditioning.
gap: NabiGuoLiu2026 proves only one direction of multiple post-fixing residual completeness and validates one depth-two graph. BhattacharyaNabiShpitser2022 identifies and analyzes causal means under fixability and ordinary-CI-generated mb-shielded geometry, but does not supply complete efficiency projection through multiple genuine Verma equalities. HristachePatilea2016 and BadeaGrivauxMuller2012 treat fixed population moment spaces or fixed known subspaces, not random nuisance-estimated post-fixing operators, observable centering error, and triangular causal inference.
fill: The corrected marginal-kernel map proves split surjectivity and tangent completeness; the explicit edge list certifies causal identification of \(E(Y^\nu)\); and coherent fitted laws with learned affine projectors yield efficient causal inference with explicit nuisance-product, centering, angle, and variance accounting.
